title: Glue Pipeline Config
description: Schema for the table-level data config JSON consumed by the Glue pipeline wrapper. Covers source tables, filters, file locations, CDC, crypto, and per-environment S3 buckets.

environments.description: Per-environment S3 bucket configuration. The wrapper resolves config['environments'][env]['s3_bucket'] at runtime.

catch_up_threshold_days.description: Number of days after which the pipeline switches to catch-up mode filters instead of normal day1 filters

source.description: Source tables organized by temporal type. Each key maps table aliases to table definitions with fully-qualified names and required columns.

non-transactional.description: SCD2 source tables with eff_start_date/eff_end_date/active columns

non-transactional-scd1.description: SCD1 source tables with dw_lod_tmp/dw_upd_lod_tmp only — no temporal columns

transactional.description: Append-only event/fact source tables partitioned by business date

file.description: File-based sources (parquet/CSV) read from S3 when io_mode is 'file' or 'hybrid'

filters.description: Filter expressions per run mode (day0, day1, catch_up_mode). Each mode contains per-source-type filter maps. 'default' applies unless overridden by a table-specific alias key.

crypto.description: Per-environment crypto/tokenization configuration. Include only when the crypto flow is active for this pipeline; omit entirely otherwise.

file_locations.description: S3 path prefixes for staging, checkpoint, and intermediate files

staging.description: Staging area S3 prefixes for flag indicators, surrogate keys, and intermediate data

staging_path.description: General-purpose intermediate staging S3 prefix. The transform constructs the full S3 URI as s3://{s3_bucket}/{staging_path}/step_name.

spark_checkpoint_dir.description: S3 prefix for Spark checkpoint data

date_columns.description: Pipeline-specific date columns beyond the standard set (eff_start_date, eff_end_date, dw_bus_dt). SourceReader auto-applies CAST(col AS DATE) for all columns in this list when they appear in filter expressions. Omit if no additional date columns are required.

date_control.description: Date control file paths and scheduling parameters

filename.description: S3 key for the date control file

backup_filename.description: S3 key for the backup date control file

file_path.description: Optional local file path override (empty string when using S3)

workday_number_monthly.description: Workday number within the month on which a monthly pipeline runs

workday_number_weekly.description: Workday number within the week on which a weekly pipeline runs

run_on_weekends.description: Whether the pipeline runs on weekends

run_on_bank_holidays.description: Whether the pipeline runs on bank holidays

cdc.description: Change data capture configuration. For NonTransactional_SCD2: include primary_key_cols, exclude_cols, snapshot_mode. For NonTransactional_SCD1: include only primary_key_cols, exclude_cols. For Transactional: omit entire cdc section.

primary_key_cols.description: Primary key columns used for CDC dedup/merge logic

exclude_cols.description: Columns excluded from CDC change detection

snapshot_mode.description: CDC snapshot mode — applicable to SCD2 sources only; omit for SCD1

rolling_deletion.description: Rolling data deletion configuration. Applicable to Transactional and NonTransactional_SCD1 tables only — must NOT be present for NonTransactional_SCD2. When enabled, TargetWriter executes DELETE FROM <target> WHERE <predicate> after each successful write. The predicate is a raw SQL WHERE clause; {current_business_date} is interpolated at runtime as an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

enabled.description: Enable rolling deletion. When false or absent, no delete is executed.

predicate.description: SQL WHERE clause for the DELETE statement. Supports {current_business_date} template variable. Examples: "dw_bus_dt < DATE_SUB(CAST('{current_business_date}' AS DATE), 90)" (date-based), "status = 'ARCHIVED' AND last_updated < CAST('{current_business_date}' AS DATE)" (custom logic).

_template_notes.description: Optional template metadata — not consumed at runtime

s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket name for this environment

columns.description: Columns required from this source table for the transformation

filterModeBlock.description: Filter expressions per source type for a given run mode. Each source-type key maps table aliases (or 'default') to SQL filter expressions.

secret_name.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret name for crypto credentials

itsi.description: ITSI identifier for crypto service in this environment

api_endpoint_url.description: Crypto API endpoint URL for this environment
